newsitem.title: UK: First Leisure not planning Rank unit buy.
newsitem.headline: First Leisure not planning Rank unit buy.

text.p: First Leisure Corp Plc chairman Michael Grade on Wednesday dismissed press speculation that the company intended to bid for Rank Group Plc's film distribution arm.
"I can't see what that would add to the business," he told a news conference.
Grade's comments came after British newspapers linked his name with reports that leisure company Rank planned to sell its movie distribution unit.
A Rank spokesman earlier this week declined comment on the speculation.
Grade, already non-executive chairman at First Leisure, was named executive chairman of the company on Wednesday.

Earlier this week, he said he was resigning as chief executive of Britain's Channel Four television station, where he played a major role in investing in hit films like "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and "Trainspotting".
